headline: Global Experience Specialists Acquires CSG Creative
summary: Global Experience Specialists (GES) has acquired CSG Creative from National Trade Productions, Inc. The acquisition is intended to enhance GES's strategic marketing and creative capabilities within the exhibition and association sectors.
why: Consolidation in the event and marketing services industry allows firms to leverage combined creative teams and client bases to drive revenue growth.

impacts.name: Global Experience Specialists
impacts.why: The acquisition expands service capabilities, which may improve competitive positioning in the events sector.
